# LogiCore Technologies - Workspace Instructions

## Project Information
- **Type**: Vite + React + TypeScript corporate website
- **Status**: ✅ Fully implemented with design system, components, and pages
- **Dev Server**: `npm run dev` (runs on http://localhost:5173)
- **Build**: `npm run build` (outputs to `dist/`)

## Project Structure
- **Components**: Atomic design pattern (atoms, molecules, layout, features)
- **Pages**: Home, About, Contact (Services, Portfolio, Why Us - pending)
- **Styles**: CSS Modules + global styles with design tokens
- **Assets**: Placeholder logos and icons

## Development Guidelines
- Replace placeholder content (logos, images, contact info) before production
- Update WhatsApp number in all components (currently: 254790010567)
- All components use CSS Modules for styling
- Design tokens defined in `src/styles/tokens.ts`
- Follow atomic design pattern for new components

## Quick Commands
```bash
npm run dev      # Start dev server
npm run build    # Build for production
npm run preview  # Preview production build
npm run lint     # Run ESLint
```
